results.description:
at right, few leaves on slender trunk. With ginger at left.
on stream bank below road and above dense streamside regen, here predominantly wheki, mahoe, kawakawa, coprosma grandifolia, mapou, ponga, with ground cover by tradescantia and scattered ginger. Lastreopsis? common, with juvs to 50cmH  emergent from, and sporelings found hidden under, tradescantia.
Scattered Kahiki ginger.2 x Tree privet over 5mH, plus 2 c.2-3mH

Later intervention:
https://inaturalist.nz/observations/22990858
